info.title: EPL Forecast API
info.description:
Forecasts for the English Premier League from a time-weighted Dixon-Coles goals
model, with walk-forward evaluation and Monte Carlo season simulation.

All probabilities are produced *before kickoff* from data available at the time.

get.summary: Monte Carlo simulation of the rest of the season
get.description: Refits the goals model on everything known at the cutoff and simulates the remaining fixtures. Results are cached in the database, keyed by the data and model version. Uncached requests are rate limited per client (429) and share a bounded pool of workers (503 when saturated); `runs` must be one of the configured sizes (default 1,000 or 10,000).

Track record: each match's latest pre-kickoff forecast and its score
get.description: One row per match: the latest forecast logged strictly before kickoff (the rule /predictions/live scores), newest kickoff first. Paged in the database. A season with no logged forecasts returns an empty page. Offset pages can shift between requests if forecasts are logged in the meantime.
